planting.note: Set out divisions or potted plants after frost danger passes; the rhizome dies back completely each winter and re-sprouts from the crown in late spring.

directions: This patented hardy begonia hybrid (USPP34895), bred by Ozzie Johnson, carries red stems topped by broad, dark olive-green leaves with a contrasting carmine-red underside. Clusters of pendent, bicolor white-and-pink flowers open from summer into fall on a slowly spreading rhizomatous clump. Grow in light, bright shade with steady moisture and rich, well-drained soil; it dies back to the ground after frost and returns reliably from the crown each spring. Works well as a textural woodland-edge planting alongside ferns and hostas.
